def maximumMatch(G):
    M = len(G)
    N = len(G[0])
    
    # Initialize the matching arrays
    match = [-1] * N
    seen = [False] * N
    
    def bpm(u):
        for v in range(N):
            if G[u][v] and not seen[v]:
                seen[v] = True
                if match[v] == -1 or bpm(match[v]):
                    match[v] = u
                    return True
        return False

    for u in range(M):
        seen = [False] * N
        if bpm(u):
            max_applicants += 1
    
    return max_applicants
